items.title: FAA ground stop still affecting thousands of flights. And, Trump meets Xi, Putin in Asia
items.excerpt: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said that things could be back to normal at the end of Monday after an FAA ground stop disrupted flights. And, Trump heads to Asia for a high-profile trilateral summit.

items.title: Chris Van Hollen says he can beat Chuck Schumer. Here's his case
items.excerpt: Sen. Chris Van Hollen told NPR's Morning Edition why he believes he can defeat Chuck Schumer and what he would change about Senate Democratic leadership.

items.title: Trump heads to Asia to meet with Xi and Putin amid Nvidia fallout
items.excerpt: The trip to China marks Trump's second time this year, and comes as the president and his party faced widespread backlash from voters in the recent midterm elections.

items.title: What to expect from Trump and Xi's upcoming meeting in China
items.excerpt: Preview of what to expect as President Trump meets with Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, China this week.

items.title: Who makes Sydney Sweeney's American Eagle jeans — and under what conditions?
items.excerpt: Sydney Sweeney has great jeans, American Eagle Outfitters tells us. But who made them? And what are working conditions like in the garment factories of Pakistan and Bangladesh?

items.title: Fuel crisis and protests pressure Chile's far-right president
items.excerpt: Chile's far-right President José Antonio Kast is facing mounting public anger, as rising fuel prices trigger transport strikes and protests across the country.

items.title: What's Trump's strategy now with Iran? To keep things as they are
items.excerpt: President Trump says the "status quo" is what Gulf Arab allies want as the Iran war hits a stalemate and the U.S. midterms force a pivot from threats of attacks to economic pressure.

items.title: Nvidia CEO steps down. And, Sen. Chris Van Hollen to run for majority leader
items.excerpt: Nvidia's chief financial officer has been appointed interim CEO after Jensen Huang stepped down from the role. And, Sen. Chris Van Hollen says he will challenge Chuck Schumer for majority leader.

items.title: Nvidia's interim CEO inherits risky AI bets and a legal mess
items.excerpt: AI expert Gary Marcus breaks down what's at stake for Nvidia and the mess its new CEO has inherited.

items.title: U.S. envoys meet with Putin in Moscow on Ukraine talks, then see Zelenskyy in Dublin
items.excerpt: U.S. envoys have met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin and with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Ireland as Washington seeks new momentum in peace efforts.
